answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 17113 Country: India Title: 1.Can a women during her menses cut her nails. 2.Can we cut the nails @ night or after magrib. Question: 1.Can a women during her menses cut her nails. 2.Can we cut the nails @ night or after magrib. Answer ID: 17113 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1759/1376/L=1430) (1) Yes, she can cut. (2) Yes, you can cut. حكى أن هارون الرشيد سأل أبا يوسف رحمة الله عن قص الأظافير فى الليل فقال : ينبغي فقال: ما الدليل على ذلك فقال: قوله عليه السلام الخير لا يوخر (عالمگيرى:5:358) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
